message: Job "build" explicitly requests a full checkout without a visible need for eager historical file blobs.
why: A blobless clone retains commit and tree metadata but fetches file contents lazily. A full clone downloads historical file blobs eagerly, which can add transfer time and storage. No visible command establishes that this job needs those blobs downloaded up front.
suggestion: Keep the checkout step. If the job supports lazy blob fetching, test method: blobless (or omit method) and verify the same tools and repository-file operations still work.
measurementHint: Compare checkout transfer size, lazy blob fetches, and total job time with the same commit history and checkout contents.
aiHandoff: Review .circleci/config.yml job "build" and test whether method: blobless avoids eager historical blob transfer. Preserve the checkout step and verify all repository-file and history operations.
